# Independent zero-temperature reference data

The 24 files contain raw alpha/sigma totals from a separately compiled extraction
of Wannier90 PR #449, commit `907008d5aa9cbacf888d470c6b5aad3beb40bc04`.
Two-band cases retain bands 2:3; three-band cases retain bands 1:3; unprefixed
files retain all four bands. Inputs are the package synthetic_runtime TB fixture, k=(0.17,0.23,0.31) or Gamma,
photon energies [0,0.1,0.73,1.7] eV, Fermi energy 0 eV, zero temperature,
resonance and low-frequency widths 0.025 eV, and sc_eta=0.04 eV.
Filenames select Gaussian/Lorentzian smearing and eta correction on/off.

Rows are real/imaginary pairs in Julia column-major flattening of
(frequency=4, component=18, quantity=2). Quantities are alpha then sigma,
before physical prefactors. Components are axis-major with pairs
xx, yy, zz, yz, xz, xy. Expected values were not generated by the Julia SHG kernel.
Finite-temperature one-band tests use a separate analytic contraction in
second_harmonic_unit.jl, with Hermitian two-, three-, and four-band matrices.
